patch_list: Append futatabi version to device info
Append the applied bundle version to the stock device-info text.
Replace the catalog Ad button with login on Aimoge and Mebuki only (ARM64).
Clone futatter for side-by-side installation. Default package suffix: .morphe. Cloning may not work on all devices.
Use dark mode when the theme is unset. Preserve saved choices and allow changing the theme in settings.
Use the futatabi launcher and stats icons, rename the home title, and tailor the settings and feedback entry. Optional.
Auto-register boards and run the local bridge with protected stock reading, replies and new threads (ARM64).
Diagnose and safely trim known Flutter viewing cache files at cold start (1 GiB soft budget, Android 8+). Never clear settings or upload files.
Restore missing adaptive launcher foreground densities from the official APK asset.
